verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm an llms.txt at https://lmstudio.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown renditions of the docs (e.g. /docs/app.md), with developer docs also served as .md pages, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting the llms.txt/markdown docs for agent use, evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-corpus bundle, independent community corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
